scholarships.title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: University of Otago | Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka

existing.description: The University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship provides funding to support international Master's students studying at the University of Otago. It pays a stipend of NZ$18,204 per annum plus a tuition fee waiver for one year capped at NZ$35,000 for Master's study, excluding the student services fee and insurance. Four awards are offered, normally one per Academic Division. Applicants must be international students undertaking a thesis-based Master's as their first Master's qualification, and selection is based predominantly on academic merit and research potential.
eligibility: Be obtaining your first Master's qualification
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be international students, be obtaining their first Master's qualification, and be undertaking a thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago. Selection is based predominantly on academic merit and the applicant's potential for research.
benefits: Tuition fee waiver for 1 year capped at NZ$35,000
Normally one scholarship per Academic Division each year
coverage: Tuition fee waiver for 1 year capped at NZ$35,000 for Master's study
Excludes the student services fee and insurance
requirements: Enrol in a thesis-based Master's programme at the University of Otago
Be an international student obtaining your first Master's qualification
Submit an application that will be picked up by one of the four annual review rounds (1 March, 1 June, 1 September, 1 November)
Check your tuition fee rate with the International Office, as the waiver is capped at NZ$35,000
application_method: Online application via the University of Otago international scholarship process
existing.selection_notes: The official page states 'Selection is based predominantly on academic merit and the applicant's potential for research.' Four awards are offered, normally one per Academic Division.
existing.best_fit: International students commencing their first thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago.
existing.notes: The Scholarship only provides support for the thesis component of a Master's Research degree, for up to 1 year of full-time enrolment. Depending on the programme of study the scholarship may only partially cover tuition fees, and the student is responsible for any tuition fees above the NZ$35,00 waiver.
existing.application_period: Continuous applications accepted year-round, with assessment rounds on 1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November.
existing.deadline_display: No fixed closing date: 'Applicants can apply anytime but applications will be reviewed four times a year (1 March, 1 June, 1 September and 1 November)'.

scholarships.title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
scholarships.degree: Doctoral (PhD and professional doctorates: DClinDent, DMA, DBA, EDd)

existing.description: The University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship is the University's main doctoral award, funding PhD and professional doctorate (DClinDent, DMA, DBA, EDd) candidates at the University of Otago in Dunedin, New Zealand. It pays a NZ$34,128 per annum stipend plus a tuition fee waiver for 36 months at the domestic rate, and excludes student services fee and insurance. Up to 153 awards are offered annually to both domestic and international applicants who are seeking their first doctoral qualification. Applications can be submitted at any time and are considered at quarterly rounds in March, June, September and November.
eligibility: Seeking to obtain their first doctoral qualification
Applying to a doctoral programme (PhD, DClinDent, DMA, DBA or EDd) at the University of Otago
Available to both domestic and international students
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to both domestic and international students seeking their first doctoral qualification at the University of Otago; candidates for the PhD and for professional doctorates (DClinDent, DMA, DBA, EDd) may apply. Selection is based predominantly on academic merit and the applicant's potential for research.
benefits: Tuition fees waived at the domestic rate for 36 months
Open to international doctoral candidates (fee differential not covered)
coverage: Stipend of NZ$34,128 per annum for 36 months (PhD)
Domestic-rate tuition fee waiver for 36 months (PhD)
Domestic-rate-capped tuition fee waiver for up to 36 months (professional doctorates)
requirements: Admission to the relevant doctoral programme
application_method: Apply online through the eVision student portal
Complete a departmental assessment; the completed submission is due by the first day of the March, June, September or November round
existing.selection_notes: Selection is based predominantly on academic merit and the applicant's potential for research; up to 153 awards are offered annually.
existing.notes: The University states it is currently reviewing the strategic direction of its doctoral scholarship programme and asks applicants to check the linked funding-announcement page before applying.
existing.duration: PhD: tuition fee waiver for 36 months; professional doctorates: waiver for up to 36 months
existing.application_period: Year-round submissions, assessed at quarterly rounds (March, June, September, November)
existing.deadline_display: Applicants can apply anytime; applications are considered at quarterly rounds held in March, June, September and November. Applications must be submitted via eVision with a completed departmental assessment by the first day of each round month.
